incidents.summary: CRITICAL ATTACK DETECTED: An external actor from 192.168.56.20 ran an automated SSH brute-force attack until it guessed a valid password and logged in, then created an unauthorized backdoor administrator account ('backdoor') and opened an outbound command-and-control channel. This is a confirmed compromise; immediate firewall isolation of the attacker and removal of the backdoor account are strongly advised.
